trajectory_and_Q_contract.admission: A hand is generation-pure iff every hero-controlled row has the current update reference generation and assignment version;only pure hands enter actor,Q and mechanism computations;all surplus/mixed/stale hands remain counted and hashed.

trajectory_and_Q_contract.Q: Independent centralized Q9 with zero output weight/bias;gamma=.999,lambda=.95;Vpi=sum legal pi*Q;delta=r+gamma*Vnext-Qtaken;backward Expected-SARSA trace;Aboost=stopgrad(Qtaken-Vpi+trace);Qtarget=stopgrad(Qtaken+trace).
trajectory_and_Q_contract.update_order: Freeze Q eval;at each actor epoch recompute Qboost and population-normalize;run inherited actor update;freeze post-actor policy and pre-critic Q to materialize one target;run exactly4 Q epochs;increment generation once.
trajectory_and_Q_contract.isolation: Actor and Q parameters,buffers,optimizers,RNG,gradients and checkpoint namespaces disjoint. Scalar value-head parameters and optimizer slots remain source-bit-identical and receive no loss/gradient.

fixed_update_endpoint.batching: Controller maintains FIFO pending complete-hand packets. It processes packets until current pure list is exactly16,384;it then stops draining and runs one update. Remaining packets stay pending and after generation increment are processed,counted,hashed and rejected if stale. No pure hand beyond index16,383 enters that update.

fixed_update_endpoint.checkpoint: Only after the116th completed audited update and all116 metric/trace rows are fsynced;no earlier/latest/best selection.
